title: Global Oppo A7 Pro and A7 Pro Max spotted on Geekbench
description: Oppo launched the A7 Pro Max in China in August and the A7 Pro yesterday, and it seems like both devices are headed to global markets as well. Both of them have now been spotted in the Geekbench online database, and there's some good news regarding the few specs that the benchmark reveals. It very well could be that both the A7 Pro and A7 Pro Max will be identical globally to their Chinese counterparts. title: The Honor Magic9 Pro Max stars in a hands-on video before its official announcement
description: The Honor Magic9 series will be unveiled at the end of this month and we think that it will have three members – the Magic9, the 9 Pro and the Magic9 Pro Max. The latter, painted in the Moss Green color that we’ve seen in teasers, starred in an early unboxing and hands-on video. The video was posted on Weibo – you can watch it here. It starts by going over the exterior of the phone. The “Oreo” style camera island of the Magic8 series is replaced by a mix of round elements and a full-width rectangle. The Honor Magic9 Pro Max stars in a hands-on video before its official...

title: Sony Xperia 1 IX may get an exciting camera upgrade
description: Sony launched the Xperia 1 VIII, its latest flagship smartphone, back in May, and released it in June. Now we already have a rumor about its successor, which we assume will be called the Xperia 1 IX. [#InlinePriceWidget,14660,1#] This device will allegedly sport a main camera with a larger sensor than the Xperia 1 VIII's 1/1.35" type. Use of a larger sensor will necessitate more space, so the Xperia 1 IX will apparently have a redesigned camera island, with a larger square area than the Xperia 1 VIII's. Sony Xperia 1 VIII If this pans out, it would be the first time Sony changed...

title: The Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra are beating Galaxy Z Fold7's sales numbers in Europe
description: Back in August, Samsung revealed that pre-orders in Europe for the Galaxy Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra and Z Flip8 were 20% higher than the pre-orders for the Z Fold7 and Z Flip7 last year. The new foldables have continued to gain momentum since then. Now, Samsung says that the combined Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra sales are 50% higher than the Z Fold7 last year (note that this stat doesn't include Z Flip sales, unlike the pre-order number). Okay, it’s two phones against one, but this shows that there was a wide foldable-shaped hole in Samsung’s Galaxy Z line-up. This conclusion is also...

title: iPhone Duo gets two official first-party cases, here they are
description: The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable smartphone, and alongside it, the company today also unveiled two official first-party cases for the device. The iPhone Duo Folio is going to be available in navy blue and taupe, and it has an integrated kickstand which supports a wide range of viewing angles. It folds away neatly when not in use. iPhone Duo Folio The iPhone Duo case is thin and light, according to Apple, and will be available in sand and navy blue. It features a protective two-part design, wrapping around both sides of the phone. iPhone Duo case Both cases...

title: This is when Apple is releasing iOS 27
description: Today Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. These devices will go on pre-order on September 12 and will be released on September 18. They will both be running iOS 27, which Apple announced back in June and has been working on ever since. Today Apple has also revealed when the stable version of iOS 27 will become available for eligible iPhones, following the usual months-long beta testing period. That date is Monday, September 14. That's when iOS 27 will be released, and it's safe to assume that iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, and macOS 27 will also be released on the same...

title: Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 get S11 chip, microphones for Audio Intelligence
description: Apple's new watches just arrived - meet the Series 12 and the Watch Ultra 4. All three (Series 12 comes in 42mm and 46mm) feature the new S11 chip, improved optical/electrical heart rate sensors, and an upgraded Health Sensing System. Apple boldly says that its new wearables have the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, something it has verified through a study of more than 1,000 participants, comparing against industry-leading competitors. Both new smartwatches will measure your heart rate every 5 seconds, while heart rate variability is measured 24 times more frequently...

title: iPhone 18 Pro and Duo pricing overview
description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max are now official and they are joined by the first foldable from the brand – the iPhone Duo. The 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max will launch for pre-order across the first wave of 65 countries, including the US, the UK, Germany, Australia, Canada, China, France, India, South Korea, and others, this Saturday, September 12. Shipments will start from September 18. Another 20 countries will get the iPhones from September 25. The iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order across the same regions and countries from October 16, with shipments commencing on...

title: Apple AirPods 5 are better, but surprisingly also cheaper
description: Apple's latest base AirPods are here, and it's all good news - you're getting better sound, more powerful noise cancellation, and the price is lower, spec-for-spec. Before we continue, let's get one thing out of the way - this is the non-Pro earbud, with the open-ear design. AirPods 5 comes in two versions - one with the regular USB-C case, and one with a wireless charging case and stem touch controls. Both models have ANC this time, and Apple claims the AirPods 5 have the the best active noise cancellation for an open-ear design on the market. Elaborating further, Apple says the...

title: It's here: Apple iPhone Duo is the first iOS-powered foldable smartphone
description: Apple has finally unveiled its first ever foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo. As usually happens these days, the rumors and leaks were all spot on (well, except for the name). The iPhone Duo's screens have the same aspect ratio, and the foldable screen has an under-display selfie camera. The titanium hinge has an integrated magnet array that satisfyingly snaps it shut. Touch ID is integrated into the side button, as you'd expect from a foldable, but you can also unlock the iPhone Duo with your Apple Watch. It has a 7.6" main folding screen and a 5.4" cover display. Both support...

title: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max arrive with A20 Pro chip, smaller Dynamic Island and variable aperture main cams
description: The iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max are here, and they may look a lot like their predecessors, but they also bring enough new additions under the hood. On the outside, we have three new colors and a smaller Dynamic Island, while the internals bring the A20 Pro chip, larger batteries and variable-aperture main cams. Burgundy is the new hero color, and it is joined by glacier (blue), black and silver. The new Pros get the same 6.3 and 6.9-inch LTPO Super Retina XDR OLED panels with the same resolution, refresh rates and brightness as the outgoing models. The new bit is the narrower...

title: Samsung details the journey of making the Z Fold8 and Z Fold8 Ultra thinner and lighter
description: The original Galaxy Fold weighed a hefty 276g – and that isn’t even the heaviest Fold. That honor goes to the Z Fold2, which tipped the scales at 282g. And yet Samsung’s latest book-style foldable is only 201g. Okay, to be fair, this refers to the Galaxy Z Fold8, which has a smaller form factor than previous Folds. This is the story of how Samsung engineers made their Z foldables both lighter and thinner. The Galaxy Z Fold7 achieved an ambitious goal. description: Mere hours before Apple's grand iPhone unveiling event is set to start, Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, has posted a mysterious video on his official X account. title: Honor Magic9 Pro Max visits Venice Film Festival, here it is in live photos
description: Honor is officially announcing the Magic9 series, including the Magic9 Pro Max, on September 28. Ahead of that, the company has showcased the Magic9 Pro Max at the 83rd Venice Film Festival. The device made its first public appearance over there, in a distinctive moss green finish. The phone has ARRI branding on its camera module, emphasizing Honor's recent partnership with the legendary film camera maker. title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro series and Duo: what to expect
description: In a few hours' time, Apple will announce its first foldable iPhone. And while we initially thought it would be called iPhone Ultra, some last-minute rumors suggest it may actually end up as the iPhone Duo. Hat tip to the Surface Duo. And while the foldable iPhone will garner most of the attention, we’re still getting two new Pro models which are expected to offer some new camera tricks, alongside the new Apple A20 Pro chip and bigger batteries. title: Oppo Find X10 series now up for pre-order, to pack 8,000mAh batteries
description: Oppo recently confirmed that its Find X10 series will launch in China later this month. While the company has yet to announce an exact launch date, it has now opened pre-orders for the Find X10, Find X10 Pro Max, and Find X10E. Alongside opening pre-orders, Oppo has also revealed a few details about the upcoming phones on Weibo. The Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max are confirmed to pack an 8,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, which is claimed to retain its capacity for up to 5 years. Meanwhile, tipster Digital Chat Station claims that the phones will offer 80W wired and 50W wireless...

title: iPhone Ultra is apparently called iPhone Duo and will be cheaper than expected
description: In a last-minute rumor published mere hours before Apple's big event today, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman claims that the long-awaited foldable iPhone will not be called iPhone Ultra, but iPhone Duo. The device was first rumored as the iPhone Fold, then a few months back every rumor started calling it iPhone Ultra, but apparently that won't be its actual name. The device is going to be offered with 256GB as base, in white and dark blue. title: Watch Apple's 'Surprise and shine' iPhone launch event here
description: The day many of you have been waiting for has arrived. Apple is holding its "Surprise and shine" launch event today in Cupertino, California, to unveil a bunch of new products, including the first folding iPhone. This will be the first launch event for John Ternus as Apple's new CEO, and it begins at 5 PM UTC. You can follow it with us by tuning in to the live stream below. The star of the show will definitely be the folding iPhone, which, a Bloomberg report claims, will be called iPhone Duo, not iPhone Fold or iPhone Ultra. title: Arm unveils CSS for Mobile 2 with Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU, C2-Ultra and Pro CPU cores
description: Last year, Arm introduced Lumex Compute Subsystem (CSS) – a turnkey solution for chipset designs. Today, the company is unveiling CSS for Mobile 2, an AI-native compute platform for smartphones. Arm CSS for Mobile 2 It is built around the Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU, which has built-in AI acceleration hardware and an Arm C2 CPU cluster including Ultra and Pro cores with SME2 (Scalable Matrix Extension) for agentic AI tasks.
